summary: Compare host-coordinated messages and GPU-initiated remote operations with explicit ownership, progress and completion semantics.
outcomes: Describe CUDA-aware MPI buffer handling and synchronization obligations.
Explain symmetric memory and completion ordering for a simple NVSHMEM exchange.
sequence: Start with a two-domain halo exchange.
Trace host-issued messages on device buffers.
Introduce one-sided put/get and symmetric allocation.
Separate local completion, remote visibility and synchronization.
Compare progress constraints, overlap and portability.

visual.question: When may a receiver consume or a sender reuse this buffer?
visual.interaction: Step sends, puts and synchronization; expose each completion boundary.

practice.task: Implement or analyze a two-rank halo exchange with explicit completion.
practice.success: Boundary values match a serial reference and all buffer lifetime obligations are explained.
